verdict.rationale: Formant documents a query API, used through its Python Cloud SDK, as the primary programmatic way for data scientists to query telemetry. The doc page is titled 'data export with the Python Cloud SDK', which directly covers pulling collected data out for offline analysis. Analytics also supports custom SQL queries, but the evidence describes these only for building dashboards. Missing for 10: details on export formats, bulk or scheduled export, documented SQL access for exporting data (not just dashboards), a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
